facts.en: Completed an office administration diploma at Fictional Mintcourt College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构薄荷庭学院完成办公室行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid appointment clerk at Fictional Birchroom Services from 2020-09 to 2023-01.
facts.zh: 2020-09 至 2023-01 在虚构桦室服务公司任有薪预约文员。

facts.en: In that role, checked room bookings, sent reminders and recorded cancellations.
facts.zh: 在该职位核对房间预订、发送提醒并记录取消事项。

facts.en: Paid recreation programme assistant at Fictional Willowcourt Community Centre from 2023-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2026-08 在虚构柳庭社区中心任有薪康乐项目助理。

facts.en: Maintains course calendars from approved instructor availability and room allocations.
facts.zh: 依据获批讲师可用时间及房间分配维护课程日历。

facts.en: Processes enrolment changes within the centre’s documented booking rules and escalates fee exceptions.
facts.zh: 按中心有文档记录的预订规则处理报名变更，并升级上报费用例外。

facts.en: Checks waiting-list order before offering spaces released by confirmed cancellations.
facts.zh: 在提供因已确认取消而释放的名额前，核对候补名单顺序。

facts.en: Helped prepare the 2025-09 autumn course schedule across 3 activity rooms.
facts.zh: 协助编制覆盖 3 间活动室的 2025-09 秋季课程表。

facts.en: The approved schedule offered 14 courses with 168 enrolment places; those places were capacity, not confirmed participants.
facts.zh: 获批课程表提供 14 门课程，共 168 个报名名额；这些名额为容量，而非已确认参与者人数。

facts.en: Personally checked room conflicts and printed course information; the programme manager approved the course mix.
facts.zh: 个人核对房间冲突并印制课程信息；项目经理批准课程组合。

facts.en: Uses booking software, shared calendars and spreadsheet waiting lists.
facts.zh: 使用预订软件、共享日历及电子表格候补名单。

facts.en: Prepares instructor packs containing approved class lists, room details and contact procedures.
facts.zh: 准备讲师资料包，包含获批班级名单、房间信息及联系流程。

facts.en: Completed the centre’s internal visitor-support induction in 2023-02.
facts.zh: 2023-02 完成中心内部访客支持入职培训。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Pinechalk Sketch Club from 2018-05 to 2020-02, arranging drawing materials.
facts.zh: 2018-05 至 2020-02 在虚构松粉笔素描社做志愿者，安排绘画材料。

facts.en: Co-created a personal booklet of imaginary park drawing prompts in 2024 with a friend; personally laid out the pages.
facts.zh: 2024 年与一名朋友共同制作个人想象公园绘画提示小册子；个人负责页面排版。

facts.en: Enjoys casual badminton and folding paper bookmarks, without any recorded sports coaching appointment.
facts.zh: 爱好休闲羽毛球及折纸书签，未记录任何体育教练任命。

facts.en: Keeps cancellations, unfilled places and refund requests separate in end-of-week programme summaries.
facts.zh: 在每周结束时的项目汇总中分别记录取消事项、空余名额及退款请求。

facts.en: Refers class-content questions to the assigned instructor and policy exceptions to the programme manager.
facts.zh: 将课程内容问题转交指定讲师，将政策例外转交项目经理。
